content.title: How to Know If You’re Ready for Debt Relief
content.text: Are you wondering if you’re truly ready for debt relief? This video breaks down the real signs it might be time to get help—and what it actually takes to get started. In this episode, Marc Russell, financial wellness board member with National Debt Relief, shares the common red flags that signal your debt may be getting unmanageable, from relying on credit for essentials to only making minimum payments month after month. Drawing from his own journey out of $80,000 of debt, Marc explains why seeking help isn’t a failure, what qualifies you for a reputable debt relief program, and how the process works from start to finish. In this video, you’ll learn: • The most common signs you may need support managing debt • Why asking for guidance is a smart, proactive move—not something to be ashamed of • What types of debt typically qualify for relief • What you do and don’t need to get started • What to expect from a consultation and how debt settlement programs generally work Whether you’re struggling to keep up, dealing with unexpected expenses, or simply feeling stuck, this video will help you understand your options and take the next step toward becoming debt-free.
